import ast, hashlib, json, subprocess, pathlib
R = pathlib.Path('/workspace')
Q = R/'python/sglang/kernels/ops/quantization'
OLD, NEW = Q/'native_q8_mmq_x32_y64', Q/'native_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4'
ADMIT_CU = '  TORCH_CHECK(row % 64 == 0,\n              "x64_y64_w4 full-tile admission: weight rows must be divisible by 64");\n'
ADMIT_PY = '    if weight.shape[0] % 64 != 0:\n        return "weight_rows_not_multiple_of_64"\n'
def norm(s):
    s = s.replace('x64_y64_w4','x32_y64').replace('X64_Y64_W4','X32_Y64')
    return s.replace('#else\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 64\n','#else\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 32\n')
assert norm((NEW/'mmq_x64_y64_w4_core.cuh').read_text()) == (OLD/'mmq_x32_y64_core.cuh').read_text()
cu = (NEW/'q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.cu').read_text()
assert cu.count(ADMIT_CU) == 1 and cu.index(ADMIT_CU) < cu.index('quantize_row_q8_1_cuda')
assert norm(cu.replace(ADMIT_CU, '')) == (OLD/'q8_mmq_x32_y64.cu').read_text()
hp = (Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.py').read_text()
assert hp.count(ADMIT_PY) == 1 and hp.count('weight_rows_not_multiple_of_64') == 1
assert norm(hp.replace(ADMIT_PY, '')) == (Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x32_y64.py').read_text()
ast.parse(hp); ast.parse((Q/'gguf_q8_mmq_x32_y64.py').read_text())
core = (NEW/'mmq_x64_y64_w4_core.cuh').read_text()
assert core.count('\n#else\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 64\n#define MMQ_Y_Q8_0 64\n#define NWARPS_Q8_0 4\n#endif') == 1
assert core.count('\n#if defined(USE_ROCM)\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 64\n#define MMQ_Y_Q8_0 128\n#define NWARPS_Q8_0 8\n') == 1
assert '\n#define MMQ_X_Q8_0 32\n' not in core
assert cu.count('../native_q8_mmq_x8/vendor/') == 3
d = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R),'diff','--','python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/gguf.py'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
minus = sorted(l[1:] for l in d if l.startswith('-') and not l.startswith('---'))
plus = sorted(l[1:] for l in d if l.startswith('+') and not l.startswith('+++'))
assert len(minus) == len(plus) == 5, (minus, plus)
assert sorted(norm(p) for p in plus) == minus
V = Q/'native_q8_mmq_x8/vendor'
names = sorted(p.name for p in V.iterdir())
assert names == ['device_compat.cuh','ggml-common.h','quantize_q8_1.cuh','vecdotq.cuh'], names
for p in sorted(V.iterdir()):
    head = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R),'show','HEAD:python/sglang/kernels/ops/quantization/native_q8_mmq_x8/vendor/'+p.name],capture_output=True).stdout
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == hashlib.sha256(head).hexdigest(), p.name
plan = json.loads((NEW/'NATIVE-SOURCE-PLAN.json').read_bytes())
assert plan['identity']=='tierengine_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4_v1' and plan['library']=='q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.so'
assert plan['helper_path']=='../gguf_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.py' and plan['diagnostics_env']=='SGLANG_Q8_MMQ_X64_Y64_W4_DIAGNOSTICS'
assert plan['tile_cuda_else']=={'MMQ_X_Q8_0':64,'MMQ_Y_Q8_0':64,'NWARPS_Q8_0':4} and plan['compiled'] is False and plan['library_sha256'] is None
for k,f in plan['source_sha256'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((NEW/k).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f, k
assert hashlib.sha256(hp.encode()).hexdigest()==plan['helper_sha256']
st = subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(R),'status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.splitlines()
allowed = lambda l: ('native_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4' in l or 'gguf_q8_mmq_x64_y64_w4.py' in l or l.endswith('python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/gguf.py') or l.endswith('iteration-proposal.json'))
assert st and all(allowed(l) for l in st), st
